title: Relay dedup entries never expire and permit authenticated preplay suppression
description: Security review of the rl7e fix in python/src/lichen/node.py found _relay_identity is collision-free over normalized IPv6 bytes, but _relay_seen has no time domain or expiry. Exact legitimate repeat datagrams remain suppressed until capacity eviction, and an authenticated peer can spoof/predict a victim's full IPv6 datagram, seed or refresh the LRU entry, and make the later genuine datagram disappear indefinitely. Define a bounded replay window/expiry based on a monotonic clock and an authenticated end-to-end packet identity or explicit packet nonce where available, without reintroducing hop/SCHC encoding instability; test stale-entry expiry, repeated legitimate datagrams, and adversarial preplay refresh.
